summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend validation. Backend: 43/43 pytest tests passed (30 iter-1 regression + 13 new iter-2). Covered: standardized error envelope (401 -> {error:{code,message},request_id}), platform-admin bootstrap via mobile 9000000001 -> is_platform_admin + PLATFORM_ADMIN role via GET /api/me and /api/capabilities; normal user has roles=['PLAYER'] & no orgs; self-promotion blocked (POST /api/admin/clubs -> 403 FORBIDDEN); admin can create two clubs, assign owners (idempotent, no duplicate memberships); owner login shows CLUB_OWNER + org; non-member gets 403 ORG_ACCESS_DENIED on /orgs/{id}/{analytics,bookings,members}; owner of Club A cannot read Club B analytics (403); booking concurrency 409 BOOKING_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE with availability endpoint reflecting the taken slot; game full 409 GAME_FULL with idempotent duplicate joins; coach availability + booking with server-side price + 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE on double-book + coach-sessions/mine listing; training plans (4 weeks, 4 drills each) + drill toggle + streak_days>=1 + list plans; rankings leaderboard includes is_me row with rank; achievements returns earned_count/total/achievements[] with earned booleans; referrals full loop -> code+share_message, apply once, 2nd apply -> 400 REFERRAL_ALREADY_APPLIED, self-code -> 400, after B joins first game A's rewards_earned>0 and referrals>=1. Frontend E2E (390x844): login 9000000001 -> OTP 123456 -> onboarding completed -> Home; Profile shows Training Plans / Rankings & Badges / Refer & Earn menu items. Training screen renders goal chips + 'Create Backhand Plan' + streak badge (0d). Rankings shows My City/Global toggle, 7 achievement tiles (Early Adopter earned), leaderboard 1..6 with 'AdminTester (You)' highlighted at rank 6. Refer & Earn shows generated code (ADMINT0C86), Copy button, Share Invite, referrals/earned/credits stats, and 'Apply' input. Zero console errors on all screens. Fixed one pre-existing regression test (test_create_booking_and_verify) that used a hard-coded date and collided with the new unique-slot index — now uses a unique date per run.
action_items: Consider adding testIDs for the coach detail (/coach/[id]) & club workspace (/club/[orgId]) screens if not already, so future e2e can hit them by testID. (Optional — not blocking iter-2 sign-off.)

Optional: expose a 'Workspaces' switcher UI in Profile when caps.organizations is non-empty (currently the club/[orgId] route exists but wasn't observed to be linked from Profile). Not tested end-to-end via UI since discover -> coach detail flow already exercises the mainline user journey.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines — still large. Bookings/games/marketplace/AI could be split into their own routers similar to features.py/org_admin.py for maintainability.
AI Coach history replay is still a text-prefix (LlmChat is not fed prior messages via its own history API). Works, but inefficient with long sessions.
In-memory OTP rate limiter (otp_service.py) will not scale across pods — code comment already flags Redis; document as prod TODO.

features.py: _referral_code is deterministic on name+user_id prefix — collisions extremely unlikely but not enforced by index; the sparse unique index on referral_code will surface conflicts if they ever happen. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (login+OTP, onboarding, home, profile, training, rankings, refer & earn)

seed_data_creation: Test users created ad-hoc via mock OTP (unique mobiles per run, TEST_ prefixed names/notes). Two TEST_Club orgs created per run via platform admin; owners provisioned via invited accounts. No prod/seeded data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split into test_kuvira_backend.py (iter-1 regression) and test_iteration2_features.py (RBAC/orgs/coach/training/rankings/referrals/concurrency). BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Platform admin mobile is 9000000001 (from PLATFORM_ADMIN_MOBILES env). Error envelope shape: {error:{code,message},request_id}. Frontend testIDs of note: login-mobile-input, login-send-otp-button, otp-input, otp-verify-button, onboarding-name-input, onboarding-city-<CITY>, onboarding-next, profile-menu-{training,rankings,refer,bookings,orders}, profile-signout. rca_of_issue: N/A — the only pre-existing regression failure (test_create_booking_and_verify) was a test-data collision with the new unique-slot index (2026-02-15 court 1 18:00-19:00 already booked from previous runs). Not a product bug. Fixed by using a per-run unique date.
